recipe.clean: LibriSpeech test-clean FLAC, decoded to 16 kHz mono by plaudon-audio, consecutive utterances of one reader concatenated and trimmed to the plan's utterance length
recipe.opus_low_bitrate: ffmpeg -i <wav> -c:a libopus -b:a 12k -ar 16000 -ac 1 <ogg>, decoded back to 16 kHz mono PCM by the same binary
recipe.room_impulse_response: image-source impulse response of a 5.0 x 4.0 x 2.7 m room, wall reflection 0.6, source (1.2, 1.0, 1.5) m, receiver (3.4, 2.6, 1.2) m, 12 image orders, convolved and peak-normalised in this tool
recipe.telephone_bandpass: two-pole RBJ high-pass at 300 Hz followed by a two-pole RBJ low-pass at 3400 Hz, Q = 0.7071, applied in this tool
